Penguins measured per island: Biscoe 32, Dream 17, Torgersen 10 (59 rows total, all counted).

Problems found and handled:
- island: row 17 had a leading space (" Torgersen"), which would have split Torgersen into two groups. Fixed with normalize_labels (low risk, auto-approved) → Torgersen now 10.
- Duplicate rows: none (0 exact duplicates).
- body_mass_g: 3 values far outside the rules range of 2500–6500 g — rows 19 (3,600,000), 24 (3,350,000), 29 (3,650,000). These look like a unit/typo error (grams vs. something else). I left them unchanged because the question only counts rows per island and does not use body mass; they do not affect the counts. They should be corrected or excluded before any body-mass analysis.
- Not used by this question, so left alone: species has a case variant ("chinstrap", 1 row) and sex has 1 missing value (rules say missing = unknown, do not guess).

Caveat: the counts are row counts of measured penguins; no rows were excluded, so all 59 records are represented.
